product_metadata.title: 50 Pack Teal Paper Napkins with Gold Foil YAY for Party Supplies (3-Ply, 5 x 5 In)
features: Celebrate Napkins: These disposable teal napkins feature the word "YAY!" printed in a festive gold foil, perfect for a bridal shower, birthday party, banquet, wedding reception, proposal party, and engagement celebration
Protect Your Surfaces: Place the decorative YAY napkins under cocktail or wine glasses to protect your table surface from water rings and stains
High Quality: Our 3-ply bar napkins (18gsm) are absorbent, soft, and disposable for simple cleanup; an excellent addition to weddings, anniversaries, and graduations
Dimensions: The square YAY cocktail napkins measure 5 x 5 inches folded, 10 x 10 inches unfolded
Comes With: You will receive 50 pieces in this gold foil and teal napkins party supplies set
description: Add these beautiful and elegant teal cocktail napkins to your party decorations! This teal napkins disposable set goes with various themes and occasions, including weddings, bridal showers, birthday parties, and bachelorette party decor. The teal disposable napkins each measure 5 x 5 inches, perfect for bar supplies, cocktail hour, and dessert tables. You will receive 50 decorative cocktail napkins for teal party supplies.
